annotations.title: List cities and suburbs with migration agencies

description: Use this when a location search finds nothing or the place is ambiguous. Lists Australian cities with their number of listed agencies, or with city set, the suburbs of that city. Names returned here work as the location in search_migration_agencies.

city.description: List the suburbs of this city instead of cities, e.g. Sydney.

state.description: Limit to one state or territory, e.g. VIC.
